item.title: Using Noteweld
item.description:
Try it without an account

Open the public editor to try Markdown, preview and optional Vim. The scratchpad lives in the tab; this example does not save it to a private account. Download anything you want to keep before leaving.

Explore the public graph for an original six-note sample. It does not read private notes or start a processing job.

Create a private workspace

Open the sign-in page , or create an email account . Complete the security check, follow the email link, then choose your name and passphrase. No account is created until you submit that confirmation form. Email links expire after 30 minutes and work once.

item.title: Building Noteweld: accounts to connected notes
item.description:
Start from the evidence

The current source is connected-notes handoff f6901ff (owner-access source record). Application code for that collection is e1b8740; earlier foundations are not descriptions of every current feature. Read the usage guide before following the implementation record.

1. Repair account and note persistence

The early registration work validated identity/password input, seeded accounts and preserved failed form input. The then-selected Neon HTTP adapter supported a batch operation rather than interactive transaction callbacks. Its mocked-transport checks were explicitly not evidence of database rollback.

item.title: Technical overview
item.description:
Current release, 7 November: Modal v23, source a2af9a3, tag direct-drive-a2af9a3, deployed at 19:26:24 Cairo. Signed-in notes now offer Upload to → Noteweld storage / Google Drive for attach, paste and drop. Drive uploads go directly to Google, retain retry state while the editor is open, and never fall back to managed storage. The destination is remembered per account in this browser. Usage/setup and evidence (source repository requires access), storage/privacy boundaries .

Existing private R2 media, verified-email signup/reset, account storage management, appearance controls and 15-minute Drive consent/expiry recovery are preserved. Production stays Free; checkout remains disabled pending Paddle approval and actual sandbox acceptance. Own-server storage, end-to-end encryption, native Neovim and offline desktop are not implemented.

item.title: Markdown and Vim editing
item.description:
Open a text note or choose Take a note…. Checklists keep their separate checklist editor.

  • Write, Preview and Split change the view without discarding source or enhanced-editor undo. Split stacks vertically on narrow screens.
  • Standard keys work by default. Vim enables normal/insert/visual modes, motions, selection and Vim undo. Use i to insert, Escape to return to normal, v to select and u to undo. Escape in Vim stays inside the note.
  • Simple text provides a native textarea for accessibility, device compatibility or enhanced-editor loading failure. Switching to/from it starts fresh enhanced-editor undo; source is retained. Settings apply to this editing session.
  • Undo, Redo, Find and the formatting buttons work in the enhanced editor. Find includes replacement. Tab leaves the editor instead of trapping keyboard focus.
  • Save or Ctrl/Cmd-S writes through the normal API. Vim :w uses the same path. Existing notes stay open after these saves; Save & close also closes. Saving a new note completes its creation. Escape/backdrop closure asks before discarding an edited note; it does not silently save it.
  • A failed save leaves the draft and undo available. If another tab changed the note, copy or download the draft before Reload saved version. Reloading is a deliberate replacement and clears the old draft’s undo history. There is no durable server revision archive yet.
  • Download .md exports the exact current body, including unsaved changes, with the title as a portable filename. It does not insert a heading or modify stored data. Account JSON export still includes all notes and labels.

Media attachments — 6 November

In a signed-in note, use Attach media or drop/paste a file. Preview displays owned images, audio and video; Manage attachments reuses or removes account files. Checklists expose the same body under Attachments and details. Free accounts have 100 MB storage, 10 MB images and 25 MB audio/video files. Removing one file makes its references unavailable wherever used. Markdown/JSON exports contain references/metadata; download original media separately. See the media manual and hosted evidence .

item.title: Links, backlinks and graphs
item.description:
Choose Link note while writing to insert a stable reference such as [[note:UUID|Readable caption]]. Search titles/labels, select a note and insert; the editor keeps your cursor position and undo. Escape closes the picker and returns focus. A stable ID survives a rename; its optional caption remains the text you wrote, while the link tooltip shows the current title. Copy a stable reference from any note’s detail page too.

You can also type [[Title]] or [[Title|caption]]. Matching uses trimmed, case-folded NFKC titles across your own active and archived notes. Exactly one match resolves. Duplicate titles show ambiguous; missing titles show unavailable. These are name lookups, not permanent identity: use the picker for links that must survive renames or replacement by another note with the same title. Empty titles cannot be looked up by name; link them by ID. No note is created or rewritten automatically.

item.title: Source bundles and provenance
item.description:
Import, review, edit

  1. Export a fresh supported ZIP from Pageweft (plain, Obsidian or LLM preset) or Sonaweft. The original PDF/recording is included only if that exporter actually includes it. Keep your own original outside the service.
  2. Sign in to Noteweld and choose Source bundles. Select the ZIP and Validate and preview. This parses and verifies it without saving notes.
  3. Review filenames, categories, excerpts, file counts and archive SHA256. Original extraction, user corrections and AI notes retain distinct labels. Hashes validate internal consistency, not provenance authenticity, model accuracy or legal rights.
  4. Choose Use existing notes (default) or deliberately create another note copy. Confirm that you may retain the files, then Import all notes together. All notes and their immutable archive commit in one transaction. A failed import saves neither. Retrying a lost acknowledgement with the same operation ID does not duplicate notes.
  5. Open an imported note, edit and save normally. Private relative assets/source links resolve through owner-checked URLs; links between imported notes use stable internal IDs. Raw ZIP bytes remain unchanged. Your edited note is separate from its original source.
  6. Download the original ZIP any time within the preview’s artifact traffic allowance. Deleting a retained source preserves its notes but makes their source/asset links unavailable. Deleting your account removes both from live storage. Operator backups expire after seven days.

Format and safety boundaries

Supported: pageweft-export/v1 in MANIFEST.json with explicit files and notes; instascript-export/v1 in manifest.json for Sonaweft. Old Pageweft demonstration archives without the current schema/index need a fresh export. Arbitrary ZIPs, vaults and account/wallet migrations are not accepted.

item.title: Deployment and recovery
item.description:
Current deployment and data

Noteweld runs its Next.js/Node application on Modal behind the public Cloudflare gateway. Neon PostgreSQL stores private account/note state. The preview has explicit account/note/source bounds and billing is closed. No shared wallet/login across the portfolio apps is implied.

Account and preference persistence

Every private operation validates the server session and owner. Browser-session revocation and account session versions control continuing access. Google/GitHub entry is configured, with actual owner grant/link acceptance still pending; matching emails never automatically merge accounts. Verified email signup and mailed recovery are deployed and passed real inbox checks. Existing key/provider recovery is preserved; accounts never silently merge.

item.title: Connected notes release
item.description:
Original record: Connected notes release — 16 October 2026.

Milestone 005 adds stable ID wiki-link insertion, safe code-aware resolution, explicit missing/ambiguous titles, owned metadata, linked-note detail pages, outgoing/backlink panels, a bounded/filterable graph and an account-free original graph example. See the guide for exact syntax, limits and architecture.

Local evidence

Forty unit/React checks and 14 actual PostgreSQL checks passed, including parser escapes/code/GFM URL boundaries, rename/ambiguity/foreign-ID semantics, maximum graph bounds/layout and actual archive/trash/foreign metadata isolation. Lint, TypeScript and the isolated production build passed. All 14 production Chromium checks passed after the final graph fitting/picker refinements, including two actual accounts, stable links across rename/trash/restore/permanent deletion, no rebinding to a replacement title, ambiguous names, picker Escape/focus, dirty link navigation, graph filters/camera and simulated metadata failure/retry. The original authenticated account/recovery, editor/Vim/export and failed-editor-chunk journeys also passed. The account-free graph was verified to make no private API requests. A further public-graph-only capture passed for visual review, without registering accounts. Runtime audit is clean at this date, with previously documented dev-only findings retained separately. Graph, editor, forms and public examples fit 320/390/768/1440. Phone/desktop graph screenshots were visually inspected; fit now uses visible bounds and SVG labels/dots retain a constant screen size. Seven supporting portfolio DOM checks passed; its publication remains pending hosted acceptance.

item.title: Markdown editor release
item.description:
Original record: Markdown/Vim release — 16 October 2026.

This collection follows the reliability foundation . It adds Markdown source/preview/split, optional Vim, in-session undo/redo, find/replace, formatting, exact Markdown downloads, guarded dialog closure and a public browser-only editor example. Checklists, account recovery, private API boundaries and revision conflicts remain intact. No database schema, original Keep data, billing configuration or NixOS settings are changed.

Evidence

Local validation passed: 33 unit/React boundary checks, 13 actual PostgreSQL checks, lint, TypeScript and the isolated production build. All 11 production Chromium checks passed, including the existing real-cookie/database/recovery journey and the new editor journeys. All three editor journeys passed again after the final mobile split-height adjustment.

item.title: Account reliability release
item.description:
Original record: Noteweld foundation release — 15 October 2026.

This milestone repairs account/note/label reliability before the connected Markdown/Vim workspace. It is a free bounded preview. Paid access, editor/graph and source-bundle imports are separate future collections, not released features.

Local evidence

  • npm test: 27 unit/React boundary tests passed, covering auth validation, driver contracts, protected fields, pending/failed UI and idempotent draft retries. Network/auth substitutions in these tests are explicit.
  • npm run test:database: 13 actual PostgreSQL checks passed. They cover account/seed commit and rollback, duplicate signup races, ownership, concurrent note revisions, trash constraints, idempotent creation, quotas, rate limits, rotating recovery/session versions, label races, migration collision rollback and logical snapshot restoration.
  • npm run lint, npm run typecheck, isolated production build: passed. nix eval .#devShells.x86_64-linux.default.name evaluated the pinned Nix shell without a system rebuild.
  • Chromium full cookie/database journey passed locally, including registration/recovery acknowledgment, failed-create retry, exact whitespace persistence, stale-edit recovery, checklist mutation/trash/restore, label rename identity, phone navigation, JSON export, password recovery invalidating an existing session and permanent account deletion. All 8 combined browser checks passed after the standalone build.
  • Auth forms and workspace widths are checked at 320/390/768/1440; 390/1440 screenshots were visually inspected. The native note dialog focuses the title; the mobile drawer supports Escape and focus return. No authenticated journey is permanently skipped.
  • Compatibility validation entrypoints import maintained project tests and pass. Private source backup precedes this work; pre-existing changes were retained.

Isolation and deployment

A new Neon database and restricted application role were created. Migrations were applied only to that empty target and the isolated local database. The original database still has two accounts and no notes/labels; its credential files were not edited. The runtime role is verified unable to create database/schema/roles or read the original accounts.

item.title: Accessibility review — 16 October
item.description:
Original record: Editor accessibility review — 16 October 2026.

The public scratchpad’s CodeMirror scroll region was flagged by axe-core 4.13.0 as lacking focusable content. The editable textbox now has an explicit tabindex=0 through CodeMirror’s contentAttributes facet, including its read-only states. Tab still exits the editor normally. This does not add a second focus target around the editor or change data, save, account or payment behavior.

Local verification: lint/types, all 40 existing unit/UI checks, isolated production build, and the existing account-free editor browser journey passed. The journey checks real Markdown download, preview/split, guarded reset/navigation, four viewport widths, Tab exit, strict production CSP and absence of POST requests. A separate local axe WCAG A/AA/2.1 AA run returned zero violations on the public example. No database/schema change was needed or made; this patch does not claim a new run of the full authenticated PostgreSQL suite.

item.title: Custom domain and account access
item.description:
Current public address

Use https://noteweld.amirgomaa.com/ . The account-free editor and graph are /example and /example/graph; private writing starts at /auth/signin. The application runs on Modal behind a fixed Cloudflare HTTPS gateway, with PostgreSQL on Neon. Vercel is not its active host.

Existing account data stays in the same independent database. Sign in again when changing hostnames; browser cookies and guest local storage do not automatically move between website origins. Matching email addresses do not merge accounts.

item.title: Accounts, recovery and connected sign-in
item.description:
Sign in and retain recovery access

Create an email account by completing the security check, following the inbox link and explicitly choosing your name/passphrase. Verified email/password accounts can request mailed resets; links expire after 30 minutes and work once. A completed reset signs out previous sessions and invalidates any old private recovery key. Existing unverified accounts retain their previous key/provider recovery. Configured Google/GitHub sign-in remains a separate method; accounts never silently merge. Each portfolio application has a separate account.

item.title: Source handoff and account release
item.description:
Original record: Source handoff and accounts — 19 October 2026.

Implemented collection

The preserved feat/account-signin foundation continues on feat/source-handoff-accounts. Private source checkpoint precedes changes. Original Keep credential files/database remain untouched. See source bundles for the actual import sequence and limits, accounts for provider setup, and the dated foundation/editor/connections records for earlier evidence.

Pageweft/Sonaweft ZIPs now have a previewed, validated, transactionally atomic import. Raw archives are immutable, account-scoped and SHA256/CRC checked; paths, expansion, encoding, references, counts and capacity fail closed. Retained asset links use authenticated endpoints; imported note links use stable IDs. Original extraction, user corrections and AI-derived text remain labelled. Idempotent retries and deliberate duplicates have distinct semantics. Source deletion preserves editable notes; account deletion cascades through sources and sessions. The source traffic allowance is explicit and conservative, not a provider bill ceiling.

item.title: Interface and appearance release — 5 November
item.description:
What is live

The approved forest interface and custom joined-note N logo are deployed. Open Appearance in the signed-in sidebar, or try browser-only appearance settings .

Choose Forest, Paper, Slate, Graphite, Ocean or Rose; light, dark or system mode; and customize 29 semantic color roles. Light and dark retain separate overrides. Text size, reading font, spacing, reduced motion, stronger borders, individual/full reset and validated theme JSON import/export are available.

Guest choices save in that browser. Signed-in choices save to the account and are included in account exports and backups. Preview changes are explicit; choose Save preferences to keep them. Low-contrast colors produce a warning, with an optional repair action that preserves the user’s ability to choose.

item.title: Google and GitHub status
item.description:
Configuration and actual use are different checks

Google and GitHub are configured for Noteweld’s public domain. Authorization request checks passed the exact callback URL, state and PKCE; Google also includes its OIDC nonce. Ordinary email sign-in and authenticated note/account operations passed the deployed release checks.

The owner’s actual provider consent, linking/unlinking, cancellation and provider-specific email cases have not yet completed acceptance. Do not interpret configuration as evidence that every external account has been exercised.

item.title: Email signup and password recovery
item.description:
Create an email account

Open signup , complete the security check and request your email. Follow the link, choose your name and passphrase, then confirm. Opening the link alone creates no account. Links expire after 30 minutes and work once. Use at least 15 characters, following the form’s full password requirements.

Recover access

Verified email/password accounts can request a reset . Completing the emailed form changes the password and signs out previous sessions. Any old private recovery key stops working. Unverified legacy accounts retain their existing key/provider methods; inbox ownership never silently merges or takes over an older account.

item.title: Images, audio and video
item.description:
Add a file to a note

Choose Upload to → Noteweld storage or Google Drive, then attach, paste or drop one supported file into the editor attachment area. Connect Drive separately in Account first. The destination is remembered per account in this browser; failed uploads never silently switch providers. Save the note after insertion. Preview shows supported images and native audio/video players; codec support depends on the browser.

Images can be up to 10 MB and audio/video up to 25 MB per file. The free account allowance is 100 MB, with at most 500 attachments. Managed files live in private Cloudflare R2 storage with a recovery copy; Drive originals remain in the connected Google Drive and do not consume managed bytes; account permissions control reads. Notes and media are not end-to-end encrypted.

item.title: Storage usage and plans
item.description:
Find your usage

Open Account → Manage storage and plan . The panel shows saved files, unfinished uploads, pending removals and remaining space. Free includes 100 MB and at most 500 attachments; images can be up to 10 MB, audio/video up to 25 MB each.

Reservations and unfinished removals count until released. Archived/trashed notes still count. Expand the library to download ready files or remove an unneeded file/reservation. Removal warns that any note using the file will show an unavailable attachment. Refresh retries a failed read; stale displayed values are labeled.

item.title: Subscription availability
item.description:
Current availability

Subscriptions and live checkout remain disabled. The current free preview includes 100 MB of managed media. Plus is planned at $5/month for 5 GB; planned capacity is not an active purchase offer.

Preparation is not a real payment

Paddle sandbox server preparation and isolated tests cover protected checkout intents, signed-event validation, duplicates, ordered state, reconciliation and owner boundaries. Local sandbox Plus storage tests never grant production storage or prove an actual purchase.

item.title: Images, audio, video and storage
item.description:
Choose where new files go

In a signed-in note, use Upload to → Noteweld storage or Google Drive. Then use Attach media, paste an image or drop a file. Connect Google Drive separately under Account → Google Drive first. The destination is remembered for your account in this browser; it is not synchronized between devices.

Drive originals upload directly from your browser to your connected Google Drive. Noteweld verifies their type and bytes and inserts private references. Save the note. Use the Google Drive panel and Choose or upload in Drive for files already in Drive.
